name: nats-server
description: Self-hosted NATS pub/sub server on Fly.io (WebSocket, single shared cred)
instructions: Add FLY_API_TOKEN and NATS_PASSWORD to packages/infra/environments/<env>/secrets.yaml. If you don't have a NATS_PASSWORD yet, run apply once and the module will print a generated value to paste in. The module creates a single Fly Machine running nats:latest with WebSocket on wss://<appName>.fly.dev.
